methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: More than 30,000 customers await broadband connections as provider struggles to complete work
signals.signal_reading: Infrastructure failure in underserved regions creates a prerequisite barrier—without broadband connectivity, 30,000+ customers in Southside cannot access even shallow AI tools, locking them out before capability development begins.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free community-led AI workshops signal grassroots capacity-building outside traditional tech hubs, indicating potential for distributed deep learning if these peer networks can achieve scale and sustainability beyond individual initiative.

signals.title: TAYLOR: AI data centers increase Virginia’s urban-rural divide - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: Data center concentration in NoVA creates infrastructure and economic gravity that reinforces metro advantages while physically manifesting the urban-rural divide in AI capability and opportunity access.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: Community-driven workforce training backed by EPA grants demonstrates localized capacity-building in historically underserved Southwest Virginia, testing whether regional institutions can build deep skills outside metro areas.

signals.title: Tony Stark’s J.A.R.V.I.S., Meet Amelia, Norfolk Naval Shipyard’s IT AI Help Assistant - DVIDS
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk Naval Shipyard deploying an AI help assistant represents shallow platform adoption within defense infrastructure—enabling immediate productivity without building deep technical capability in the workforce.
